name: Kasama (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kasama city emblem in green and blue: two interlocking loops in green and blue forming a stylised letter K.
history: Municipal flag of Kasama, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 19 March 2006.

features.role: Kasama city emblem — two interlocking loops in green and blue forming a stylised letter K
